reply.text: POTS is one for your doctor or a physio to map out with you — especially around intensity limits and how you progress. What I can help with on the training side: once you've got that clearance, a lot of people in that situation do better starting with recumbent or seated cardio (bike, rower) rather than upright standing work, since it puts less strain on blood pressure regulation, and building duration before intensity. Tell me what your doctor clears you for and I'll help you build cardio around it.
